differences.native: MySQL computes each yearly overlap with DATEDIFF(LEAST(period_end, year_end), GREATEST(period_start, year_start)) + 1.
differences.app: SQLite computes the same inclusive difference with julianday(MIN(period_end, year_end)) - julianday(MAX(period_start, year_start)) + 1 and casts it to an integer.
differences.rationale: SQLite has no MySQL DATEDIFF, LEAST, or GREATEST functions. The three yearly UNION ALL branches, overlap predicates, sales multiplication, aggregation, aliases, grouping, and ordering otherwise follow the Accepted query exactly.
